key_insight: For WC–Co–Cr coatings, detonation spraying delivers higher hardness, while HVOF provides a dense, uniform microstructure and low friction.
engineering_relevance: Powder morphology and spray-process selection can help tailor coatings for machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compare detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluate coating microhardness and tribological behavior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports average detonation-coating microhardness of 1449 HV and an HVOF friction coefficient of Kt = 0.143.
watch_item: Test conditions, variability, and quantitative wear rates are not provided in the abstract, limiting application-specific durability conclusions.
paper_title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
